findings.title: Unrecognised metadata namespaces
findings.detail: Keys outside the standard namespaces: maya. Usually harmless, but runners ignore them, so they are a place to hide data.

findings.title: Template adds fixed text the model will read
findings.detail:
Review this text; it is sent to the model with your messages: 
  - "<|system|>
# Tools

You may call one or more functions to assist with the user query.

You are provided with function signatures within <tools></tools> XML…"
  - "</tools>

For each function call, output the function name and arguments within the following XML format:
<tool_call>{function-name}<arg_key>{arg-key-1}</arg…"

findings.detail: This template does not match any official template in the database. That is normal for fine-tunes and new models; read it with --dump-template if the model will get tools.
